topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Rain's been pelting the city nonstop, like it's trying to wash away all the lies. Got a case now, a guy swears he invented this gizmo, only to find out some slick-talking weasel's already got it patented. Doesn't surprise me, the way people carve up the truth when they smell a payday. This city, it's a meat grinder, and honest work gets chewed up, spit out as so much greasy slime on the sidewalk. I told him, "This town's full of sharks with suits, and you just handed one a sandwich." He looked ready to chew through brick, but he don't know the first thing about getting justice. Gotta dig deep, peel back the layers, find out if there's a way out of this mess, or if we're just another case of the same old song.
